public_body: Governing Board Of The Cape Cod Water Protection Collaborative
overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the April 29 notice's topics were specific enough for the items actually discussed, though it suggested spelling out "MBL" in future notices.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the April 29 meeting notice did not list topics with enough specificity to inform the public of what the Board would discuss.
allegations.key_passage: Each of the topics the Board discussed during its April 29 meeting was sufficiently described by the meeting notice.
